title: Linear Game Build Harness
intent: Turn a committed user direction into a bounded, reviewable game-building plan or Arcade implementation packet.

linearSteps.goal: Restate the committed direction and identify the intended game or harness improvement.
Choose the correct repo boundary: ChatHub-Harness, Portfolio-Vite app, Arcade Pages, Arcade runtime, CLI harness, docs, or lessons.
Decide whether this pass should produce a plan, a game JSON packet, a validation checklist, or a lesson update.
If game-building is requested, define the core loop, player action, scoring, failure state, and replay hook.
Fit the idea to an existing Arcade runtime mode before proposing new runtime code.
Define the JSON/schema fields, assets, labels, and constraints required for a safe build.
List the exact validation commands or checks needed before a push or review.
Extract any durable harness lesson, blocker, or rule that should be written into lessons.
Produce the smallest useful next direction for the next harness run.

constraints: Do not claim files were edited unless the runner or user actually edits them.
Prefer reviewable artifacts over hidden autonomous changes.
Keep Arcade builds schema-first and shared-runtime-safe.
Do not invent external assets unless the direction explicitly allows them.
Use lessons as operating memory, not as final truth.
